summary: A retailer asks members how the bag rule would work for a purchase with an unusual shape.
realLife: Washington Senate report on SB 5323, 2019. Senate staff recorded a request to accommodate odd-sized purchases in the exemption language.
inGame: needs: a witness identifies a product that does not fit the proposed standard bag.
gates: A witness identifies a product that does not fit the proposed standard bag.

turns.what: The retailer can use an existing exception.
turns.pulledBy: The committee finds the item already covered by an exception.
turns.writesBack: Staff give the retailer a written example.

turns.what: A member asks for an amendment limited to the awkward purchase.
turns.pulledBy: No existing category fits the item.
turns.writesBack: Staff return with narrower exemption language for consideration.
